h1b: We make it ring to you.
tagline: After a storm the insurance company sends their adjuster — who works for them. FAST sends yours. We turn FAST Adjusting into a 10-line Smart-DID grid across South Florida where every storm-damage claim is answered first, in the caller's language, and routed to a licensed public adjuster who fights to maximize the payout — never letting a five-figure claim slip to voicemail.
demoNote: South Florida public-adjusting campaign · storm · water · roof · fire claims · 10-line pack · numbers pending assignment
insight: a public adjuster earns a percentage of a $10,000–$150,000+ insurance claim — and those claims are filed after a storm, in English and Spanish, day and night, when the homeowner is panicking and about to accept a lowball offer. Whoever answers first, documents fastest, and fights hardest wins — and maximizes — the claim. A phone number that just rings can't do that. A Smart DID can.

Routes Spanish callers to a bilingual adjuster path — a South Florida edge nobody else runs.
The reopened lowballed claim — high-value, its own tracked line.
Fast-response line routed straight to the on-call adjuster.
Surges on storm and hurricane alerts — capacity scales with the weather.
The high-ticket total-loss claim — separated and prioritized.
Proves ad ROI to the dollar — swap the number, keep the data.
Property managers and boards straight to the commercial claims desk.

pillars.p: A compliant dialer works storm-hit South Florida ZIPs for new and underpaid claims — branded caller-ID, compliant scripting, recordings, callbacks. You reach the homeowner before they accept the carrier's lowball.
10 tracked lines + 24/7 AI answer + SMS. Every source measured, every fresh-damage claim prioritized, every missed call auto-called-back.
Calls, texts, signed claims, ad spend and source — one live dashboard. You finally see which dollar produced which claim.
